notes.title: We did lots of stuff!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44660384/9a40e81f9edf93d4bbe2dccdc6d5faaf10d416cb.jpg[/img]

Greetings!
As you may or may not know, the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2335790/Future_Breach_64/] full version [/url]has now been released!
In this update for Youngblood, we added the various fixes and improvements from the full version for a better experience - like, you can adjust your FOV and frame rate cap and stuff!  Oh, and you can now decrease the pixelation!
Now, you may have asked yourself (actually, I bet that you didn't which makes it all the more important) if there is a difference between the Demo and Youngblood, well, THERE IS. In youngblood, you get several additional missions and a chance at an enemy incursion, so it's more content than the demo. So, if you've just played the demo and didn't get the full game yet, try this!

- the full version just go a big overhaul, including the addition of the steam workshop, and the community is coming along, we will be glad to see you there!
cheers!

notes.title: major update 2
notes.content:
- you can now drop weapons (k), and also when you pick up a weapon you drop the old one and it doesn't just disappear
- AI improvements 
- health system is now more realistic
- the enemy team will appear on the 3rd mission
